verify_notes: Two independent sources for the same tree, joined by matching AMI/register code: MASAF sheet 61/D612/FI/09 (girth 357 cm, height 30.0 m, no age) and RAMI id 6501 'Cipresso Giardino di Boboli' (surveyed 14 Oct 2021, height 28 m, age given as 375 years 'calculated from the registered birth year', coordinates 43.764714/11.251004, about 9 m from MASAF's pin, consistent for a tree-level fix). Height differs 28 m (RAMI 2021) vs 30 m (MASAF): minor register drift, not flagged as a real conflict, use the RAMI figure as more recent. Age of 375 years is RAMI's own stated figure, not something this pass derived from girth; the underlying documentary basis for 'registered birth year' was not found independently, so age_min/max is banded rather than treated as exact and the writer should hedge the number as an estimate rather than a fact. General corroboration only, not proof for this specific tree: Treccani and multiple garden-history sources describe Boboli's cypresses as renowned 'cipressi secolari' (centuries-old), consistent with but not confirming the 375-year figure. Location: Piazza de' Pitti 1, inside the Boboli Gardens proper (not to be confused with the unrelated 'Bobolino' hillside garden where flo_007/015/016/017/019 already stand, about 0.76 km away). This is a genuinely new stop, not a duplicate of any live Florence tree; nearest live entry is flo_007 (Cedar of the Bobolino) 0.76 km away and flo_001 (Orto Botanico cluster) 1.75 km away. Species page: use the same canonical name already live on flo_018 and flo_022, 'Mediterranean Cypress (Cupressus sempervirens)', not 'Italian Cypress' or 'Cipresso comune', for hard rule 9 consistency. The Boboli Gardens is one of Florence's most-visited sites, paid entry via the same ticket as Palazzo Pitti/Uffizi, so access is unambiguous and well signposted; this is the strongest access case of any candidate checked this pass. curation_status flagged only because the age figure's documentary basis is thin, not because existence/species/location are in doubt.
